about.title: About
about.vision: To become the digital infrastructure of chess in Benin, then in the sub-region.
about.mission: Training players, running quality competitions, following everyone's progress and showcasing Beninese talent.
about.p1: Chesspirit brings coaching, competitions, ratings, directory, shop and media for chess in Benin together in one ecosystem, with a single account per player.
about.p2: The Chesspirit rating acts as a de facto national ranking in blitz, rapid and classical until a federal ranking exists, with FIDE Elo shown alongside.
about.p3: The tournament manager is free for every organiser in the country: each tournament run on Chesspirit enriches the national database of players and games. The first Chesspirit tournament takes place on Saturday 3 October 2026 at the FSS in Cotonou, with the FSS and Ayelade Chess as partners.

q.account: How do I create an account?
q.register: How do I enter a tournament?
q.minors: How do I register my child?
q.data: How do I exercise my data rights?
q.organizers: I am an organiser: how much does the tool cost?

a.account: Click “Sign in”, enter your phone number (or e-mail) and the code you receive. The account is created on first sign-in; you then complete a short profile.
a.register: On the tournament page, click “Register”. After signing in, your registration is pre-filled; you choose how to pay and receive a ticket with a QR code.
a.payment: Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Celtiis Cash) and bank cards, through a secure payment provider. Chesspirit never sees your card number.
a.onsite: Yes, when the organiser allows it. Your place is reserved and you pay at the desk on tournament day.
a.rating: An internal rating computed with the Elo method after each rated tournament, in each time control. It does not replace FIDE Elo, shown alongside when you have one.
a.minors: Add your child under “My account › Family”, then register them from the tournament page. Their public profile stays limited and without photo.
a.data: Under “My account › My data” you can change your consents, export your data and request deletion.
a.organizers: The tournament manager is free for every organiser in Benin. Contact us to use it.

rankings.intro: National ranking by Chesspirit rating in blitz, rapid and classical. Only players with a public profile and an established rating are listed.

rankings.note: “Chesspirit rating”: an internal rating, distinct from FIDE Elo.

method.title: How ratings work
method.p1: The Chesspirit rating is an internal rating computed with the Elo method, with coefficients close to FIDE's. It is always called “Chesspirit rating”, never just “Elo”, to avoid confusion with the official list.
method.p2: After each game, the actual score (S: 1 for a win, ½ for a draw, 0 for a loss) is compared with the expected score (E), which depends on the rating gap.
method.k40: K = 40: fewer than 30 games, or under 18 with a rating below 2300.
method.r1: Four ratings per player: over-the-board blitz, rapid and classical, plus a separate online rating.
method.r2: Only Chesspirit-rated tournaments change over-the-board ratings; forfeits do not count.
method.r3: Players with a FIDE rating start at their FIDE rating in that time control; others start at 1200, a provisional rating replaced by their performance after 5 games.
method.r4: Rating changes for a tournament are computed from pre-tournament ratings, then rounded.
method.r5: The calculation can be replayed from the full game history: an approved correction triggers a recalculation. The official list is published on the first day of each month.
